issue: Duplicate application for the same job with an already-used email is accepted
actual: After submitting as test.user@example.com for job-1, a second application with the same email (name "Duplicate Person") was submitted and showed "Application submitted!" with no duplicate warning. Employer dashboard now lists BOTH records under Senior Frontend Developer (Applications count went 2 -> 4: "Duplicate Person / test.user@example.com" and "Test User / test.user@example.com").

evidence: Clicking dashboard.jobs.item.job-1.applications expanded "Applications (4)" listing the 4 applications belonging to that job; other jobs show their own counts (job-2: 1, job-4/6/7: 0).

Each application renders as a distinct record with name, email, optional phone, message and submission date, e.g. "Alex Johnson / alex.j@email.com / 555-0101 / Jan 20 / I have 6 years of React experience...". Optional phone correctly omitted for the record submitted without one.

Valid submission showed "Application submitted!" confirmation and appears exactly once under Senior Frontend Developer in the dashboard with the submitted data (Test User / test.user@example.com / 555-0142 / "I am very interested in this role.").
Dashboard lists 5 employer jobs (job-1,2,4,6,7); dashboard.stats.active-jobs=5 matches the listed rows, and dashboard.stats.applications=5 matches the sum of per-job counts (4+1+0+0+0).

issue: Salary range validation missing — minimum greater than maximum is accepted
actual: Posted a job with Minimum Salary=200000 and Maximum Salary=100000 (all other fields valid). Instead of an error, the app showed "Job posted successfully!", redirected to the dashboard, incremented Active Jobs 5→6, and created the listing displaying an inverted range "$200k - $100k". (Missing required fields ARE blocked by native HTML5 validation, but the min<=max rule is not enforced.)

issue: Newly created records show an off-by-one relative date ("Yesterday" instead of today)
actual: Browser current date is Thu Aug 27 2026. A job posted moments earlier displays "Posted Yesterday", and the applications submitted moments earlier ("Test User", "Duplicate Person") both display "Yesterday" in the employer dashboard, instead of "Today"/the current date.

evidence: Posted "Cloud Security Specialist" (Engineering, Contract, Seattle WA, 110000-150000, description, skills AWS + Threat Modeling). Got "Job posted successfully!", dashboard Active Jobs 6→7 with the job listed, and it appears in the job-seeker list (count 8→10 incl. earlier test job) and on its detail page with all entered values. Note: salary renders as "$110000 - $150000/hr" — the form labels the input "annual" but contract jobs get an "/hr" suffix.

"nurse" → 1 result (Registered Nurse, title match); "TECHCORP" → 4 results all TechCorp Solutions (company match, uppercase); "kUbErNeTeS" → 1 result DevOps Engineer (skill match, mixed case). Count text updated immediately with each keystroke set.

Industry=Marketing → 2 (both Marketing); +Type=Part-time → 1 (Part-Time Content Writer); +Location=Austin TX → 0; Location=Austin TX alone → 2 (QA Automation Engineer, Marketing Manager). Resetting all three to "All" restored "Showing 10 jobs".

Each search keystroke/filter change refreshed list and count instantly without reload: "nurse"→1, "TECHCORP"→4, "zzzznotarealjob"→"Showing 0 jobs" with "No jobs found" empty state; Marketing+Part-time+Austin→0 empty state. Clearing search and resetting all filters restored "Showing 10 jobs" / 10 cards.

Delete on "Product Designer" opened an alertdialog ("This will permanently delete ... and all its applications"); Cancel left the job and counts unchanged (7 jobs / 5 apps). Confirming Delete removed it: dashboard 6 jobs / 4 applications (its 1 application also removed) and the job-seeker list dropped to "Showing 9 jobs" with job-2 absent.

issue: No persistence — all data resets to seed state on page reload
actual: After reloading http://localhost:7003/: the 2 jobs published during testing ("Cloud Security Specialist", "QA Automation Engineer") are gone, the deleted job "Product Designer" is back, and the list returned to "Showing 8 jobs". Dashboard reverted to 5 active jobs / 3 applications with job-1 back to 2 applications (my 2 submitted applications lost). localStorage and sessionStorage are both empty — state is in-memory only.

issue: Job editing is not implemented — no edit capability exists anywhere
actual: The employer dashboard exposes only "toggle-applications" and "delete-job" controls per job (no edit/update button in the DOM); the job detail page has no edit affordance either. The plausible route /employer/edit-job/job-1 returns "404 — Oops! Page not found". An employer therefore cannot change a published job's details.
